title: Preserve the initial wrong-ID mailbox refusal instead of turning a repeated read into readKeyExpired
outcome: An initial keyed read refused because the mailbox is absent or the caller is not a participant returns the typed pre-page notEntered refusal and releases only its owning bridge intent; a repeated ordinary read preserves that cause rather than manufacturing readKeyExpired. Genuine expired/uncertain frozen reads keep their documented recovery semantics. The distinct unreproduced Nov 7 correct-ID participant-mailbox 404 remains open in w-ec6ad041bb96.
acceptance: The wrong-ID initial-read 404 'mailbox not found for this session' and its retained-key 410 on an identical ordinary read are identified and fixed by the typed pre-page refusal and owning-intent cleanup in bc5f240e, with a discriminating regression test. The distinct, unreproduced Nov 7 correct-ID participant-mailbox 404 is preserved as unresolved work in w-ec6ad041bb96 and is not claimed fixed by this item.
The 410 readKeyExpired observed with no central restart is explained (which frozen page/key expired and why) and either prevented or documented as expected with its retry rule

The item notes account for the wrong-ID 404/410 path and explicitly distinguish the original Nov 7 ~03:10Z correct-ID 404 report, its unavailable raw input/result and its transfer to w-ec6ad041bb96. No claim that every failing call used a wrong ID, or that the correct-ID incident is resolved, remains as the accepted explanation.

completion.summary: Landed bc5f240e fixes the wrong-ID initial mailbox refusal/retained-key 410 path. Fresh independent revision-2 acceptance d274085389e0473cbbae6f0090594551 passes all 3 criteria. The unreproduced Nov 7 correct-ID participant-mailbox 404 remains OPEN in w-ec6ad041bb96.
